summary: Added public provenance::mark_in_place(&mut Value, &str), returning (), with annotation logic shared by the existing marked(Value, &str) API. The implementation borrows the existing payload, retains field-presence rules and declaration order, annotates unknown commands with false and an empty list, and leaves non-objects unchanged. Added eight integration tests covering payload allocation retention, field-presence edge cases, nested arrays, declaration order, repeated annotations, unknown and fieldless commands, non-objects, and agreement between the two entry points. Only provenance.rs and the new integration test file were changed.
